thread:
sara: FYI support ticket from Acme - they say their invoice is ~12% lower than the dashboard token count for last week. They attached screenshots.

mike: ugh. any known ingest outage last week?

sara: There was a brief event ingestion hiccup on 2025-11-04 between 02:40-03:15 UTC, Ops incident id INC-2025-453. I filed support->billing but raising here to coordinate replay/backfill + reconciliation.

toni: timeline? did we drop events or just delay?

alex: logs show a Kafka partition leader flapping, consumer lag spiked. We started the replay job but it errored halfway with a duplicate key error in the ledger apply step.

sara: error snippet from replay run: ```ERROR: apply_event_batch failed: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "ledger_event_pkey" (txn id=0x1f4a)```

kevin: that means the replay tried to write events that had already been applied (partial success). We need an idempotent apply or dedupe pre-step.

ops-bot: @oncall eng-infra alerted: replay worker restarted x3, throttled due to DB deadlocks.

lisa: finance flagged that invoices were generated before the backfill completed. We should avoid issuing credits until reconciliation is deterministic.

mike: plan proposal: 1) stop current replay 2) run replay with `--dedupe-by-event-id` and a small batch window 3) run `reconcile_metering.py --start 2025-11-04T02:00Z --end 2025-11-04T04:00Z --verify-checksums` 4) generate delta report for billing. Thoughts?

alex: agree. add step 2a: export list of applied event_ids from ledger for that window, feed into `replay --skip-if-seen` to avoid pkey collisions. I can export with `psql -c "COPY (SELECT event_id FROM ledger WHERE ts >= '2025-11-04T02:00Z' AND ts <= '2025-11-04T04:00Z') TO STDOUT" > applied_ids.csv`

toni: also watch out for partial aggregation results in the OLAP dashboard caches. We should invalidate caches for affected time slices after replay completes.

kevin: I'll own the replay/dedupe. Tentative window 30m from now. Need DB ops standby for deadlock mitigation.

lisa: finance wants an interim customer message: "We're investigating a discrepancy caused by a delayed events backlog; we'll reconcile and follow up with any invoice adjustments." I'll draft and share.

mike: action items: @kevin run dedupe replay, @alex export applied ids and coordinate DB snapshot, @toni prepare cache invalidation script, @lisa draft CS comms, @sara track support ticket and update Acme.

kevin: starting export now. hitting an unexpected permission error when trying to COPY as the replay user. ```psql: FATAL: permission denied for relation ledger```

alex: I can do the export as a superuser and drop the file on S3. Doing it now.

kevin: got the applied_ids.csv, starting replay with `replay-tool --from 2025-11-04T02:00Z --to 2025-11-04T04:00Z --skip-seen-file s3://ops/applied_ids.csv --batch-size 500`

ops-bot: replay job 8792 started on worker-a (pid 12244).

kevin: replay progressed ~40% then worker hit deadlock during ledger writes. Restarting with `DB_LOCK_TIMEOUT=12000` and lowered concurrency to 4.

toni: cache invalidation script ready: `invalidate_cache --metric metering.tokens --start 2025-11-04T02:00Z --end 2025-11-04T04:00Z`. Will run after replay finished.

mike: how long for reconciliation?

kevin: replay completed at 1799998920 (now). I've run `reconcile_metering.py` against the ledger and eventstore. Reconciliation found +145,392 tokens that were missing from invoices. Re-run checksum: OK.

lisa: finance: that's ~ $1,270 delta for Acme (preliminary). We need to decide: issue prorated credit or manual invoice amendment?

mike: recommend credit for speed. record the reconciliation report in billing ticket and attach ledger diffs.

sara: sending update to Acme now with ETA ~48h for credit processed, attaching preliminary report and note that we're performing final verification.

billing-bot: Created billing adjustment BA-2025-778 for customer Acme (amount $1,270). Pending finance approval.

kevin: follow-up ops notes: replay dedupe logic needs improvement; filed issue INFRA-1729 to make `replay-tool` default to idempotent apply and to emit a dry-run `--what-if` diff.

mike: good. long term: add a pre-invoice reconciliation window for any incident >5m with event lag. INFRA-1730.

lisa: finance approved BA-2025-778, will post credit within 2 business days and confirm to customer.

sara: Acme acknowledged and said they appreciate the quick follow-up. Closing support ticket once credit posted.

mike: thanks all. please paste any final artifacts (replay command, applied_ids.csv location, reconciliation report link) under the incident doc. I'll mark incident INC-2025-453 as resolved after we confirm credit posted.

alex: artifacts uploaded to s3://incidents/INC-2025-453/replay/ (replay.log, applied_ids.csv, reconcile_report.json).

kevin: note: replay.log shows one event duplicated in incoming stream but dedupe prevented double-write. Added test case to replay unit tests.

sara: noted. closing this thread once finance confirms. :white_check_mark:
